proposed_facts.reason: Descriptor and callback records match the explanation. The canonical installer consumes on_init, gobj_proc and callback3, not callback1 or flags. Compiled section membership is explicitly excluded.
The complete load-hook definition is an empty parameterless void function; StageData identifies its load-callback role. It returns normally.

Admission uses state 0 and a strict squared 3D radius test, then stores the fighter and s16 delay and requests presentation/feedback. The fighter-library call forwards feedback parameters; separate BarrelWait entry changes motion state.
Canonical occupancy processing confirms null-keep fallthrough into firing setup and the later unguarded pointer dereference. Separate cleanup resets state and pointer under its own guard.
Cleanup requires state 1, asserts keep and tests retained-object byte 2 against 8. Ordinary launch also accepts p_link 8, so invalidation cannot be inferred from that number alone.
Canonical GroundVars declares xC6 as s16 and keep as Fighter_GObj*. The cleanup byte access belongs to the retained object, not the selector.
Initialization assignments and downstream rate consumers support the corrected xEC role. The proposal appropriately leaves xE8 unclassified.
All three controllers match canonical branch timing, strict thresholds and fallthrough. The launch is link-guarded; state 4 does not clear keep. Ground_801C5440 confirms the sound request.
Bird placement selects the camera boundary or the absolute ±200 clamp, so placement need not be beyond the boundary. Timer and visibility behavior agree.
Positive-countdown expiry and initially nonpositive timers take distinct branches. Height, depth, subtree selection and range resampling match canonical code and rand_range.
The shadow predicate uses a local origin and makes no direct gameplay writes. The independently inspected origin helper can set up a parented joint's matrix.
The predicate returns true only for strict greater-than; equality, lower and unordered comparisons return false. The helper-effect qualification is supported.

contradictions.reason: Accept deferral of compiled .data membership, including its registration link: source establishes authored objects and relationships but not compiled placement. Retain the supported source-level registration knowledge.

Accept deferral of all .rodata/.sdata table-purpose, extent, padding and participation claims. The source proves switches, not compiled dispatch tables. The associated safe-cancellation claim is contradicted by null-keep fallthrough.

Accept deferral of .sdata2 literal-pool identity, contents and load/immutability claims without compiled evidence. Eight weighted target orientations do not restrict actual launch to eight directions: launch uses current rotation.
Accept the installer correction: stored callback1 and flags are not consumed by the current shared installer.
Accept correction of non-returning terminology for the empty void load hook.
Accept separation of stage admission from fighter motion-state entry; the final admission call supplies feedback rather than transferring motion state.

Accept occupancy and cleanup corrections: null keep does not safely cancel, numeric 8 does not itself establish invalidation, and xC6 is s16. Defer runtime reachability and retained-object lifetime invariants rather than inventing guarantees.

Accept corrected initialization and controller explanations: xEC controls animation rate, braking occurs in rotation state 0, occupancy thresholds use old postincrement/postdecrement values, and 0x12A is a sound request.

Accept both bird corrections: ±200 are absolute clamps rather than camera offsets, and 7 is an argument to the completion query rather than an animation identity. Supported bird names remain useful and unchanged.
Accept both shadow corrections: strict comparison semantics are preserved, while a blanket exclusion of caller-visible effects is narrowed because origin resolution may set up a joint matrix.
